_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the judge returned them; each why is abridged by the run from the judge's report.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 5, 9, 2 and 4 clear the bar; 6's rail on A-frame legs and kit worker, 7's white yard, 8's floating chain, 3's bright trailers fall short.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world and key with a real motif; 3 and 8 outside the palette; 4 a plan board.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals trace; the cover's Sugar Land kicker places the wait in Sugar Land; 'Four properties' doesn't name its set; 'Half the floor' is a ratio of two lower bounds on different measures; 'month of work' loosens c12; 'Where the parts go' goes past c6; 'two official records' counts the 10-Q twice.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, what and where; no county, utility or deadline.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover sets the wait, 2 pays, turn at 7 lands, 9 lands; 8 movable, 3 and 4 long on property.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, reads as filing summary, 'drawn to illustrate' on six.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh story in a familiar kit (56, 59, 62, 68).

one_sentence_fix: Change the cover kicker to the release's own scope, rename 'Four properties' to the set it is, then rebuild frame 6 around the stakes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Kit worker dominant; string line a thick rail on A-frame legs; horizon band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Shrink the worker to the far stake, eye at 0.5 m by the near lath, hairline cord.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Modules float in a chain; grey lower half.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Seat modules in ports, crop to one switch, drop the rest to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: White yard, no jamb, plastic worker.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark jamb over the left third, darken the apron.
Highlight on the clerestory, trailer doors down two stops, warm the wall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid-brown field, fingers cropped, no tape corner.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back, fingers on the tape corner, floor to black outside the light.
